P1: The search was requested for 30 days but evaluated only for the last 12 days, and its status is partial. The 120 refunds all went to cards from one country, but that covers only 12 days. Refunds to other countries in days 13–30 are unchecked, so we cannot tell.

P2: The link took effect at 09:40 Monday, before the 10:00 scoring. However, the system learned of it at 15:00 Monday, after the scoring. The evidence was not available to the check at 10:00, even though it was effective by then. So the check did not miss available evidence. The answer is No.

P3: Refunds rising from 1 percent to 6 percent in a week is a sixfold increase, and a card is linked to a closed account. That warrants review. The question asks whether it warrants review, not whether M is guilty. The answer is Yes.

RESULT PN-012 | P1: Cannot tell | P2: No | P3: Yes
